macro_themes: Q4 markdown persists: BTC is down 8.14% over 7 days and remains substantially below its 20D, 50D, and falling 200D SMAs; current spot volume is below its 20-day average.
Pure fiat stablecoin supply is contracting on both 7-day and 30-day measures; slight weekly outflow deceleration is not a confirmed liquidity turn.
USDT's 13.45 bps discount signals redemption pressure, while the near-neutral Coinbase premium does not show meaningful institutional accumulation.
Negative BTC funding and perp basis, Extreme Fear, and subdued Telegram views fit capitulation-watch conditions, but do not confirm spot absorption or an upward trend.

Multi-week Q4 markdown from ~$87.4k (late Sept) -> $76k (late Oct) -> $59.8k (Nov 24): BTC trades -10.9% below 20D SMA ($67.5k), -20.5% below 50D SMA ($75.6k), and -16.6% below a falling 200D SMA ($72.1k).

Crucial stablecoin divergence: headline stablecoin supply fell -1.11% (-$3.18B 7d) mostly due to yield-bearing USDe contracting under low perp funding, whereas pure fiat dry powder (USDT+USDC, $244.03B) is down only -0.27% (7d) with +0.52% WoW 2nd-derivative acceleration.

Active fiat redemption blocker remains: Kraken USDT/USD trades at $0.99900 (-10.1 bps below peg) and FX-adjusted Coinbase Spot Premium is flat (-0.6 bps), showing US institutional spot buyers have stopped panic-dumping but have not yet begun aggressive accumulation.

Derivatives positioning is washed out and asymmetric to the upside once spot bids return: Hyperliquid BTC 8h funding flipped negative (-0.0062%) with -4.8 bps perp discount to oracle, while Deribit 24h Put/Call volume ratio hit 1.14 (DVOL 54.3) at Extreme Fear (11).
Cross-asset backdrop: US Fed Net Liquidity ($5,824.5B) expanded +$23.1B (+0.40% 4w), while October Nasdaq AI-capex valuation fears and rotation into Gold/Silver dominated KOL macro narratives.

verdict_history.direct_answer: No — this is NOT the start of a bull run yet; the market is in late-stage Capitulation / Bottoming Watch (40/100), where forced selling, negative perp funding (-0.0062%), Extreme Fear (11), and decelerating USDT+USDC outflows (+0.52% WoW) signal seller exhaustion, while -10.1 bps USDT peg redemptions and BTC trading -20.5% below its 50D SMA block bull ignition.

No. Today's move is not a confirmed bull-run start: BTC is down 8.14% over 7 days and 2.34% over 24 hours, while fiat stablecoin supply is contracting, BTC remains far below its key moving averages, spot volume is below average, and all 12 benchmark majors are negative over 7 days. Extreme fear, apathy, and washed-out derivatives support a bottoming watch, not an ignition call.
